# V2 Lens v0.1.0-beta.1

This is the first public beta of the V2 Lens structural HL7 v2 parser and
desktop inspector for Racket 9.2 on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Included

- Lossless structural parsing with immutable raw values and exact source spans.
- A local desktop inspector with readable field labels and source highlighting.
- Recoverable diagnostics and retention of unparsed message parts.
- Cancellable parsing and bounded desktop input and rendering behavior.

## Install

```sh
raco pkg install --auto https://github.com/CodeDraig/v2-lens.git#v0.1.0-beta.1
```

Launch with `v2-lens`. See the README for the 5 MiB parse limit, 100 MiB file
open limit, structural limit, and intentionally absent interpretation features.

Report reproducible problems through
[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/CodeDraig/v2-lens/issues). Follow the
repository security policy for private vulnerability reports.
